chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, who said: I sent a message to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him).

That I have young brothers, so when does Zakat become obligatory upon their wealth? He (peace be upon him) said: When Salat becomes obligatory upon them, Zakat becomes obligatory. I said: So what about those upon whom Salat is not obligatory? He (peace be upon him) said: When they are traded with (i.e., their wealth is used in commerce), then purify it (pay Zakat).
ai.seo_question: When does Zakat become obligatory on the wealth of young children or orphans?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the timing of Zakat liability for minors by linking it to the onset of religious duties, specifically noting that while prayer obligations often begin around age seven, the financial obligation of Zakat is tied to the nature of the wealth. It establishes a distinct ruling for commercial assets, mandating Zakat even if the child has not yet reached the age of religious accountability for prayer, provided the wealth is actively traded. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the economic reality of the asset rather than solely the personal status of the owner in matters of wealth purification.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub who said,

‘I sent a message to Abu Abdullahasws that there are young brothers for me, so when would the Zakāt be Obligated upon their wealth?’ Heasws said: ‘When the Salāt is Obligated upon them, the Zakāt would (also) be Obligated’. I said, ‘So what about the ones whom the Salāt is not Obligated upon?’ Heasws said: ‘When you trade with it, so purify it (pay Zakāt)’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Yunus ibn Ya‘qub who has said the following: “I once sent (a letter) to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, to find out when Zakat becomes obligatory for the assets of my small brothers.

He (the Imam) said, ‘When Salah (prayer) becomes obligatory up on them, Zakat also become obligatory; however, in the case of those of them on whom Salah (prayer) is not obligatory but their asset is used in business, you must pay Zakat for such assets.’”
